sections.title: P07.5 completion
sections.text:
Product move: ten scheduling contracts and data types now live in `CoreX\Scheduling`. `corex-wakeup` implements them and still owns `DueWakeupSweeper` and `WakeupScheduleHint`. Notifications tags `WakeupHandlerDefinition::TAG` and `DueWakeupSource::TAG` when digest is enabled and no longer writes `corex-wakeup.handlers`. An enabled digest without a bound `WakeupScheduler` is `InvalidConfiguration` (`DigestSchedulerCheck` and `SqlDigestBuilder`). Disabled digests still freeze a batch and do not resolve or call the scheduler. `corex-tasks-workflow` no longer suggests `corex-wakeup`. The package graph forbids `axiomasoft/corex-notifications → axiomasoft/corex-wakeup` and the tasks-workflow wakeup allowlist entry is gone. `Scheduling` is kernel module 16, between Observability and Settings.

Base: `66085716452c921b965fd1331b9ad729c07d04db`.

sections.title: Self-check
sections.text:
| Decision | Implementation | Test |
|---|---|---|
| D96.8 kernel `CoreX\Scheduling` contracts, no aliases | `packages/core/src/Scheduling/{Contracts,Data}` | `SchedulingContractTest`, golden delta |
| D96.9 tag registration, duplicate kind is `InvalidConfiguration` | `WakeupBindingsRegistrar::definitions`, `NotificationsDigestRegistrar` | `DuplicateWakeupKindTest` |
| D96.10 notifications does not require wakeup; enabled digest without a scheduler is a violation; tasks-workflow drops suggest | `packages/notifications/composer.json` require, `DigestSchedulerCheck`, `packages/tasks-workflow/composer.json` | `DisabledSchedulingTest`, `DuplicateWakeupKindTest` |
| D96.11 notifications must not depend on wakeup | `scripts/package-graph-gate.php` R6, `scripts/package-graph-gate.json` | `PackageGraphTest`, `package-graph-negative.txt` |
| D100 disabled digest does not resolve a scheduler; enabled null fails before writes | `SqlDigestBuilder`, digest factory | `DisabledSchedulingTest`, `SchedulingContractTest` |
| D102 kernel module list 15 → 16, old enum R1, unknown module R1, baseline unchanged | `scripts/module-layout.json`, `scripts/ownership-map.json`, glossary, package-root `*Registrar.php` root entry, `TemplateDatabaseCloner` | `module-layout-old-enum.txt`, `module-layout-unknown.txt` |

The module-layout gate exits 0 on the 16-module enum. `AccessAzguardRegistrar` is the package-root composition registrar, so the gate counts `*Registrar.php` beside `*Module.php` and does not weaken R1. `CreateDatabaseFromTemplate` depends on `TemplateDatabaseCloner`; `TemplateClonePostgreSQLManager` implements that port and stays in Provisioning Internal. The old enum still R1s the ten moved Scheduling files, and an UnknownModule probe still R1s. `scripts/module-layout-baseline.json` was not edited.
